public_rationale: Anthropic's documentation confirms the factual core: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool in which the Claude model uses conventional tools (shell commands, file edits, search). It is more than a chatbot. But calling this a 'neurosymbolic system' is a choice of label with no agreed test. Some would count an LLM calling deterministic tools as neurosymbolic, and others would not. 'Special-purpose' is also contested, since Anthropic says the same harness powers many non-coding uses. The claim turns on definitions, so it cannot be fairly scored true or false.
limitations: The result depends on how 'neurosymbolic' is defined.

criteria.support_condition: An agreed definition of 'neurosymbolic' that Claude Code's documented architecture meets, together with evidence that it is built only for coding.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An agreed definition that excludes an LLM-plus-tools agent, or evidence that Claude Code is a general-purpose agent.
